    cassette

    Source: vignettes/knitr-test.Rmd
    knitr-test.Rmd

    This vignette tests that we can replay cassettes created by vcr::setup_knitr().

    req <- request(httpbin$url("/get"))
req_perform(req)
#> <httr2_response>
#> GET http://127.0.0.1:45343/get
#> Status: 200 OK
#> Content-Type: application/json
#> Body: In memory (270 bytes)
    req <- request(httpbin$url("/get?x=1"))
req_perform(req)
#> <httr2_response>
#> GET http://127.0.0.1:45343/get?x=1
#> Status: 200 OK
#> Content-Type: application/json
#> Body: In memory (286 bytes)
